comment: Professor Zinn kept online class interesting and thought provoking. He is always willing to help and answer questions during/after class. Grading criteria is pretty straight forward-follow the instructions. I would take any of his courses.
I absolutely enjoyed his class and would definitely take another class with him if I could. The course material was interesting, and the class was engaging.

The class is a 'reset' for adult students to build the necessary skills required for their academic careers.  Professor Zinn led the class as a seminar style with little front loading. He respected all students and encouraged participation.  The assignments (9 total) were fair and relevant, and designed to keep you on track. I would recommend him.
I have taking two classes from this professor and I enjoyed the class and the format in which it was presented. He keeps everyone engaged and was very helpful when I needed assistance.

If you want a professor that is two-faced and doesn't help his students then he's for you! He likes to tell people not judge except it only applies to the gay community. His "no judgement" rule doesn't apply to everyone as he judges himself. He has zero respect for parents that attend school. Grades are based on what he likes and doesn't like.

The class itself was very interesting. The discussions were great and the topics were controversial. Be prepared for your views to be disrespected and to be forced to listen to and write about liberal views. If you speak an opposing view... Your grades will reflect his approval of you.
